remarks: Updated colonial in convenient Westover location. Westover Woods is an enclave of fine homes yet minutes from downtown, golf, restaurants, and trains. This well cared for 4 bedroom home is filled with updates, and an open concept kitchen family room. Two story entry foyer, pristine hardwood floors on the main level, large DR and cozy LR both with crown moldings. Kitchen is sunny and bright, complete with stainless steel appliances, center island, granite countertops and more.The new sliders in the dining area open to a maintenance free deck. Family room has vaulted ceiling with a stone fireplace. Laundry and half bath on the main Level.Master Bedroom complete with two walk in closets and its own bath.other bedrooms are large with plenty of closet space. Lower level is stunning with a wet bar, hoe theater, play area, and full bath. This wonderful home won't last long.
